feature: Theme pill: light/dark toggle on Profile
detail: CLAUDE.md says single theme with no toggle. Worktree commit 27d455b says dark mode is mobile-only (Chris, 2026-10-15) and ships the --m-* light/dark tokens (globals.css), useThemeStore (key 'fieldscout-theme') and the head script. No UI calls toggle(). If CLAUDE.md is confirmed stale, this is only a UI binding.

feature: Profile mobile layout (Profile header, identity row, stat grid, scroll-away header)
detail: /app/profile (profile/page.tsx, profile-header.tsx, profile-stats.tsx) has the data. Today it is the desktop v7 'My stats' layout with a PageHeader and Edit/View public profile buttons.

feature: Display name line ('Dalton')
detail: profiles has no name column, and ruling 2026-08-05 makes the handle the only name. Show the handle as the title or drop the line.

feature: Profile avatar source (team colour + hard-coded 'D' vs profile photo)
detail: The prototype reuses the league team avatar colour (OQ11). The app has profiles.avatar_url and initials via UserAvatar, which is the natural source.

feature: '· N leagues' count under handle
detail: use-leagues.ts provides the leagues. Gated by featureFlags.leagues (test cohort).

feature: Stat tile 'Ranking accuracy #N'
detail: profiles.cred_rank, weekly_rankings.accuracy_score and cred_scores.average_accuracy exist but nothing writes them. There is no grading cron, and the app shows '—' placeholders.

feature: Stat tile 'Titles'
detail: Derivable from leagues.champion_team_id joined to team_managers. Leagues are flag-gated.

feature: Fate of current Profile content not in the mobile spec (cred score, scout tier, following, cred progress, accuracy rows, ranking history, edit/public-profile links)
detail: profile-stats.tsx and RankingHistoryCard. Cred is a core business rule, so decide where it lives on mobile.

feature: 'My stuff' section with Rankings/Lists/Start-Sit segmented control
detail: The Segment component exists in ui/tabs.tsx. The default segment is unresolved (OQ14). The Rankings and Start/Sit segments depend on the weeklyRanks/bigBoard and startOrSit flags, which are off at launch.

feature: Rankings preview rows with Submitted/Saved/Finalized and top-% grade
detail: Weekly ranks are big_board_weekly lists per week. The weekly_rankings table (submitted_at, accuracy_score) is unused, and there is no submit or grading pipeline. A plain saved-boards list could come from big_board_weekly.

feature: Lists preview rows (players · Ranked/Tiers/Video · Updated)
detail: useLists, plus lists.player_count, ranking_mode, tiers_enabled, updated_at and list_links for video.

feature: Profile row deep links and create buttons (New ranking / New list)
detail: /app/lists, /app/lists/[listId], setCreateListOpen and /app/weekly-ranks exist. The app can deep-link to the exact list (OQ6).

feature: Mobile tab bar Home · Community · Players · Profile with avatar item
detail: bottom-tabs.tsx is Home · Lists · Players · Search · More, with no Profile/avatar tab. Community is behind featureFlags.community. The IA change needs a ruling.

feature: My start/sit screen and Profile Start/Sit preview
detail: The start-or-sit pages are PlaceholderPage and there is no API route or hook. start_sit_questions/start_sit_votes (migration 001) are unused and flag-gated (startOrSit).

feature: Multi-option start/sit with Sit mode and pick-N ('Start 2 of 4')
detail: The schema supports only player_a_id/player_b_id, start-only. Needs options[], a mode and a pick count.

feature: Trade questions (give/get, Accept/Decline, recorded decision)
detail: No question type or trade fields in the schema.

feature: Roster attachment on questions ('roster attached')
detail: No column links a question to a league roster. The default-attach behaviour is a question (OQ16).

feature: Question resolution: actual points, 'you started him', verdict box, 'Your calls right'
detail: correct_player and resolved_at exist but nothing resolves them, and no cron does. The user's actual start/sit decision is not stored (it could come from team_lineups if a roster is attached).

feature: Questions / Votes received stats, All/Open/Closed chips, card list sort
detail: Needs a 'my questions' read API. vote_count_a/b only cover 2 options. Sort by close time instead of week (OQ18).

feature: Own-vote counting consistency in totals and percentages
detail: The prototype counts your own vote in totals but not in percentages (OQ19). It also says '1 votes' (OQ9) and 'crowd leans A. ' (OQ8).

feature: Start/sit composer ('Ask a question')
detail: /app/start-or-sit/new is a placeholder. The chosen close time must be stored (OQ7).

feature: Result-row headshot with team ring
detail: PlayerAvatarImage (players/player-image.tsx) and getTeamColors (lib/nfl-team-colors.ts) exist.

feature: My start/sit back target and dock
detail: Back goes to Home rather than Profile (OQ3). The league tab bar shows on a non-league screen (OQ4).

feature: League settings 13-tile grid overlay and its entry point
detail: Unreachable in the prototype (OQ1). The app has /app/leagues/[id]/settings with 6 index sections (settings-index-ops.ts) reached from league More. The tile-to-section mapping needs a ruling.

feature: Settings tiles General / Draft / Playoffs / Scoring / Draft results / Stat corrections
detail: settings-panel sections, draft-config-fields, playoff bracket, scoring-editor, /draft/recap and /corrections all exist. Draft and Stat corrections are fully built although the prototype shows a 'coming next' toast.

feature: My team tile: rename team
detail: use-rename-own-team → POST /api/leagues/[id]/teams/[tid]/name.

feature: My team tile: team avatar colour and player nicknames
detail: teams has no avatar or colour column, and nothing stores nicknames.

feature: Notifications settings tile
detail: Account NotificationsCard keeps toggles in local useState and never saves them. There is no league notification-prefs storage.

feature: Commissioner note tile
detail: There is no note field. leagues.description and the league_chat message board exist and could be reused if Chris rules so.

feature: Co-owners tile
detail: The team_managers role CHECK allows only 'manager' (063). 053 marks co_manager as reserved post-v1.

feature: League history and Previous seasons tiles
detail: Leagues are single-season, with only the current champion_team_id. There is no season rollover or league lineage.

feature: League legend tile
detail: Static explanatory copy with no data dependency. The prototype shows a toast only, so the content needs writing.

feature: Mobile toast styling and duration
detail: use-toast/toaster exist (TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY 1,000,000 ms). Duration is 1800 ms in code vs about 2.2 s in the README (OQ13).

feature: Account settings on mobile
detail: /app/settings exists (avatar, password, notifications, scoring, sessions). The prototype's Menu › Settings says 'Not part of this prototype' and no mobile design is given.

feature: Device chrome (status bar, notch, home indicator)
detail: Prototype frame only. The home indicator paints under the tab bar (OQ20).
